hold.help: What the session does when it reaches the end of a turn.

enabled.help: The tooth. false ends every turn where the agent asks to end it.

mostInARow.help: The turns the tooth carries one after another before it lets go.

wanted.help: What the owner wants said at the end of this turn.

hook.help: The hook: start the index behind the bridgehead, and click again to stop it.

open.help: Open the window, on its log tab, in a terminal beside the editor.
keys: w s move up and down the log
enter open the details, and enter again closes them
pgup pgdown step a whole window
home the first line, end the newest, and it follows

level.help: The level this box writes at. info writes every line a door says, and debug writes what the hooks see too.

editor.help: Open the work tab, which draws every ticket and takes a cell edit.

pull.help: Take the ticket waiting on you first, and open it.

new.help: Open a new ticket under the name the press asks for, with a process to pick.

failsBeforePerson.help: The times a step fails back before the pull puts a person step in, asking the reason.

personSigns.help: The stronger door on a person's hand. Switched on, a person's hand-back on a tracked ticket meets a signed tip.

refusalsBeforeFail.help: The times one hand-back meets refused before the pull fails the leaf back with the findings.

retroCap.help: The tickets a retro's improve step mints, so the list holds what gets done.

retroReaders.help: The hands a retro's collect spawns, each taking the next chapter until none stands.

staleAfter.help: The age of a held group's tip that puts it under yours.

stepsBeforeSplit.help: The person steps a ticket carries before the pull refuses another and asks for a split.

vehicle.help: Make a vehicle: a copy of this tree that works on itself, in the folder the press asks for.

stub.help: Make a stub: a bare project this vehicle drives, in the folder the press asks for.

binding.help: Where the session takes its work from. The chapter The engine controls, under spec/design_output/config.md, says what each value means.

ceiling.help: The score where the gate names the band rewrite in its log line.

enabled.help: The door holding the owner's prompt first. false takes it out.

warnAt.help: The score where the gate starts writing a warn line to the log.

words.help: The words an answer holds outside its code and tables.

budget.help: The time the whole check takes at most. Past it, the check prints a warning naming its slowest part and its slowest cases. 0 switches it off.

runs.help: The check's runs the stamp keeps at one commit. A retro reads each part's median over them.

handBack.help: The median time a hand-back takes to land over a group of many tickets, with about ten times headroom over a box's measure, and 10 where that stays under a millisecond.

pull.help: The median time the pull takes to hand out a leaf over a group of many tickets, with about ten times headroom over a box's measure, and 10 where that stays under a millisecond.

resolver.help: The median time the guidance resolver takes over many notes, with about ten times headroom over a box's measure, and 10 where that stays under a millisecond.

stale.help: The median time the query for stale steps takes to read, hash and compare the notes a hold names, with about ten times headroom over a box's measure, and 10 where that stays under a millisecond.

fileLines.help: The lines a file holds at most. The write door refuses a write that grows past it.

functionLines.help: The lines a function holds at most. The write door refuses a write that grows past it.

handoverAt.help: The context past which the next pull after the ticket in hand hands the handover, the clear and the read of the handover. 0 switches it off.

finish.help: The calls the finish hold lets pass before it stops hard.

update.help: The calls the engine lets pass after the owner asks for an update, before the ask refuses them.

change.help: The model a helper runs on that makes a scoped change with its test, or reviews against a list.

decide.help: The model a helper runs on that takes a design, an unknown cause, or a verdict the owner reads.

find.help: The model a helper runs on that finds, lists, reads and reports.

wait.help: the seconds an agent's call waits on its action, where the call sets none
the seconds a call over /v1 waits on its action, where the request sends no Prefer: wait=N
the seconds a tool call over MCP waits on its action, where the call sets none

cage.help: The cage, switched over in phase 5. The hooks IO module answers each hook event.

check.help: The check twins, switched over in phase 4.

config.help: The config readers, switched over in phase 4.

guidance.help: The rules a step reads, switched over in phase 4.

log.help: The session log rows, switched over in phase 4.

lsp.help: The LSP's rules: old answers on the LSP's own sweep alone, shadow runs the check module's sweep beside it and logs each finding apart, new answers the module's.

opentasks.help: The open-tasks slice's record, switched over in phase 2. The badge, the work tab's brackets and its queue column read the index.

phase0.help: Phase 0, the specs. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take the-migration-writes-its-specs. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase1.help: Phase 1, the foundation. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take the-foundation-lands-unchanged. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase10.help: Phase 10, Node leaving the boxes. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take node-leaves-the-boxes. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase11.help: Phase 11, the verbs leaving Node. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take the-verbs-run-in-go. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase1gaps.help: Phase 1, its gaps. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take the-foundation-closes-its-gaps. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase2shadow.help: Phase 2 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take open-tasks-shadow-lands. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase2switch.help: Phase 2 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take open-tasks-switch-lands. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase3shadow.help: Phase 3 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take read-topics-land-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase3switch.help: Phase 3 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take read-topics-switch-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase4shadow.help: Phase 4 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take quack-verbs-land-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase4switch.help: Phase 4 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take quack-verbs-switch-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase5shadow.help: Phase 5 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take go-cage-lands-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase5switch.help: Phase 5 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take go-cage-switches-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase6shadow.help: Phase 6 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take tui-shell-lands-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase6switch.help: Phase 6 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take tui-shell-switches-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase7shadow.help: Phase 7 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take lsp-door-lands-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase7switch.help: Phase 7 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take lsp-door-switches-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase8shadow.help: Phase 8 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take sidebar-lands-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase8switch.help: Phase 8 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take sidebar-switches-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase9shadow.help: Phase 9 in shadow. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take module-processes-land-in-shadow. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

phase9switch.help: Phase 9 switched over. true in the tracked file on main lets a cloud box take module-processes-switch-over. A write on this box turns nothing on in the cloud.

processes.help: The processes, switched over in phase 9. The index spawns the IO process and one process a placement.

prose.help: The prose checks, switched over in phase 4.

sidebar.help: The sidebar: old draws its own groups alone, shadow weighs the views section against them and logs each pair apart, new draws the views section.

verbs.help: The road a verb runs, switched over in phase 4. Each verb quack answers runs alone.

window.help: The window, switched over in phase 6. It draws the index's reads alone.

words.help: The words a file, a folder and a branch name each hold at most.

keepDone.help: The span a done or cancelled operation stays under ops. Zero keeps it.

keepFailed.help: The span a failed operation stays under ops. Zero keeps it.

everyCalls.help: The calls between two asks of the engine's three questions.

grace.help: The calls that pass after the ask, before every call waits on the plan's answer.

mostOpen.help: The todos the plan holds open, past which the third question stays away.

placements.help: the lists of module instances that share one process, where each instance in no list takes a process of its own

cap.help: The size up to which one tool answer reaches the model whole. Past it, the client hands back a preview.

margin.help: The room the pull keeps free below the cap. A hand-out past cap less margin splits, and the next pull on the step prints the rest.

block.help: the score a ticket takes for each ticket its chain holds up

day.help: the score a ticket takes for each whole day it stands

fail.help: the score a ticket takes for each hand-back that failed on it

pointer.help: The run a heading shares with the heading its pointer names before the rule draws.

rule.help: The run two rule lines of two guidance notes share before the rule draws.

most.help: The span the wait tool holds at most before it returns with no signal.

quiet.help: The span a file stands unchanged before the wait reads it as quiet.

backoffCap.help: The longest wait before a restart.

backoffFirst.help: The wait before the first restart of a part.

beat.help: the seconds between two ticks of the manager

deadlineAction.help: The span an action's operation ends within.

deadlineDerived.help: The span a derived provider with a pending input commits within.

deadlineFold.help: The span a fold with a pending event commits within.

faults.help: The faults inside the window that raise an alarm and stop the restarts.

lease.help: the seconds the index's own lease holds past a renewal

window.help: The span the faults of an alarm fall inside.
